title: Pilot pack: open cancer driver-gene track (Open Targets CC0 x GENCODE, hg38)
context: To prove the end-to-end build flow and de-risk the cold-start problem, M0 requires one pilot pack built from a clearly-permissive Priority-A source and verified loadable in a real browser. The chosen source is Open Targets (CC0) target lists projected onto GENCODE gene models on hg38 — both are Priority-A and have no redistribution restrictions. The pilot also validates the license+data-tier gate, coordinate/assembly gate, manifest model, and UCSC hub generator in a real build, and demonstrates self-serve hosting so the hub URL is loadable by anyone without a partner.
objective: Build the pilot cancer driver-gene track pack (Open Targets CC0 target list x GENCODE on hg38) end-to-end: pass both gates, build bigBed track files with per-feature provenance, emit a UCSC hub, render-verify it, host it at a loadable URL, and record the outcome or surface the adoption blocker.
acceptanceCriteria: Source is Open Targets (CC0) target list projected onto GENCODE gene models on hg38; licensegate-002 PASS artifact is committed with permitsRedistribution: true and cited clause/URL.
coordgate-003 PASS artifact is committed recording the assembly (hg38), coordinate convention, and format validation result.
bigBed track file(s) built with per-feature provenance (source, release, record ID, license); provenance completeness score ≥ 90/100 recorded in the manifest.

UCSC hub emitted (hub.txt, genomes.txt, trackDb.txt), hubCheck clean, and render-verified by loading into UCSC or JBrowse and confirming cancer driver-gene features appear at expected loci on hg38 with evidence recorded in outcomes/pilot-006.json.
Pack hosted at a self-serve loadable URL (GitHub Pages or Zenodo) with attribution and an explicit not-medical-advice notice.

outcomes/pilot-006.json records render evidence and adoption status (confirmed use by a third party, or the adoption blocker explicitly surfaced); verifiedNeed updated to true only on confirmed adoption.
output: output/packs/pilot-driver-genes-hg38/ — bigBed track file(s), UCSC hub files, manifest JSON, gate artifacts, and outcomes/pilot-006.json render/adoption evidence.
